findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so uploaded objects are not required to be encrypted at rest. This bucket stores a customer-master spreadsheet, increasing the risk of sensitive customer data being stored without an explicit encryption control.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so financial data uploaded to it is not required to be encrypted at rest.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so operational data uploaded to it is not required to be encrypted at rest.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so data-science data uploaded to it is not required to be encrypted at rest.
